args.body:
• Newsletter (Bellwether Office): This week's issue covers warehouse automation in 2026, linking to the main article and a free companion piece (registration via email, no password).
• Main article: Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece: The biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks.
args.title: Bellwether Office: Warehouse Automation 2026
